privacy.scope: honest clients only; adversaries retain their declared behavior
privacy.adjacency: replacement of one honest client's complete data, conditional on fixed public identities, partition and record counts
privacy.sensitivity: 2C; independently released client updates; no sampling amplification
privacy.zero_noise_control: honest updates clipped at the unchanged pilot C without additive noise

method: original published frozen scorer and parameters; historical source loaded only after digest verification
extensions: unchanged published CGSV/RFFL kernels and pilot-selected parameters; shadow rewards only
trajectory: sample-count-weighted FedAvg over all sampled released updates; every rule sees one identical immutable matrix
failure_policy: retain every declared cell, numerical failure and completed prefix; no replacement updates or survivor-only full-horizon intervals
privacy_limitations: Public-seeded simulation noise is reproducible, not a deployment privacy guarantee. Ideal Gaussian accounting excludes public-benchmark calibration and data-dependent failure signals.
